title: GdprProcessingPrinciple
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — data processing principle under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Article 5 defines seven foundational principles that all personal data processing must satisfy. The controller is responsible for and must be able to demonstrate compliance with all principles (accountability). Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Article 5(1)(a)-(f) and Article 5(2).

principle.description: One of the seven GDPR processing principles. LAWFULNESS_FAIRNESS_TRANSPARENCY: processed lawfully, fairly, and transparently (Art 5(1)(a)). PURPOSE_LIMITATION: collected for specified, explicit, legitimate purposes (Art 5(1)(b)). DATA_MINIMISATION: adequate, relevant, limited to what is necessary (Art 5(1)(c)). ACCURACY: accurate and kept up to date (Art 5(1)(d)). STORAGE_LIMITATION: kept no longer than necessary (Art 5(1)(e)). INTEGRITY_CONFIDENTIALITY: appropriate security including protection against unauthorised processing, loss, destruction, damage (Art 5(1)(f)). ACCOUNTABILITY: controller responsible for and able to demonstrate compliance (Art 5(2)).

principleCompliant.description: Whether the processing activity complies with this principle.

complianceEvidence.description: Reference to documented evidence demonstrating compliance with this principle. Source: GDPR Art 5(2) accountability obligation.

assessmentDate.description: Date of last compliance assessment for this principle.
